catShortTh: การกำกับดูแลความปลอดภัยสารสนเทศ

name: Selection of service providers and outsourcing of confidential information management
content:
When outsourcing the management of critical systems that contain confidential information, do you select an entity that meets one of the following requirements?

1. ISO27001 certification, and ISO27018(*) certification if personal information is retained.
2. Able to present to clients a SOC2 (type2) audit report showing the results of third-party audits in terms of availability, confidentiality, security, privacy, and integrity
3. 24/365 monitoring, timely application of vulnerability patches, and multiple vulnerability inspections per year
4. Confirmation that the person in charge of information management is able to comply with the confidential information management policy stipulated by ITGR, and regular monitoring of the management status.

*Equivalent certification standards (ISO27701, etc.) are acceptable.
standard: 1) One of the requirements in 1, 2, 3, or 4 on the left must be satisfied.
evidence:
① ISO certification, etc.
① SOC2 reports
② Verification record
catShortTh: การกำกับดูแลความปลอดภัยสารสนเทศ

name: Security training for employees
content:
Are the following conditions satisfied for employee security training?

1. Conducted upon hiring and then at least once per year
2. Records kept of training attendance history
3. Conducted in a way that ensures that all employees receive training (in a group or by e-learning) and in a way that cannot be skipped, such as simply sending an email
4. Contains a comprehensive list of items that all employees should be aware of on a daily basis
standard:
① Must conduct new hire training, and training must be conducted at least once per year, for all employees
② Must save a training attendance history for the above
③ Must make use of methods equivalent to group training and e-learning
④ Must include content equivalent to training material templates provided by Marubeni
⑤ Must review training content at least once a year
evidence:
①②③ Training history over last year (document listing participants, dates, trainee names, and training procedures)
④⑤ Training content (materials, videos, etc.)
catShortTh: การกำกับดูแลความปลอดภัยสารสนเทศ

name: Provision and dissemination of IT environments to employees
content:
Are all of the following measures taken after employees are provided with or informed of IT environments (IT devices, software services, network environments, etc.) used for business?

1.Inform employees that, in principle, personal use of the environment and business use other than personal use of the environment (including desktop use of personal PCs and posting of business information on external SNS and websites) are prohibited.
2. Checking alerts and reports on security measures issued by Marubeni and informing employees of them as necessary
standard: ① Must train employees or inform them individually about items 1 and 2 to the left
evidence: ①Training materials or individual memos
catShortTh: การกำกับดูแลความปลอดภัยสารสนเทศ

name: Access permission control for important systems
content:
Is there a system for controlling access permissions based on affiliation, job title, work, etc. (browse, update, delete, etc. digital information) for critical systems(*)?

*Systems (file storage, email servers, authentication servers, systems that hold strictly confidential information, systems subject to IT general control, important infrastructure systems, etc.) where compromised confidentiality, integrity, or availability could result in serious consequences for the operations of the organization

evidence: ① Screenshots of access permission configuration screens, etc.

name: Account and access permission approval for important systems
content:
Are all of the following procedures implemented for issuing, changing, and deleting accounts and access privileges for critical systems?

1. General accounts are authorized by the Information Manager, and administrator accounts are authorized by the IT Manager.
2. A record of the above authorizations are retained for at least a year.
3. All of the following requirements for the scope and separation of authority are met.
    1) The scope of access permissions is limited according to affiliation and position.
    2) The requester and approver of account access permissions are separate.
    3) IDs are separate for the payment requester and verifier and for the developer and operator.
4. Once used, an ID must not be reused for a specified period.
standard:
① Must establish procedures that satisfy items 1, 2, 3, and 4 to the left for all important systems
② Operations must be in accordance with the procedures mentioned above
evidence:
① Documents describing procedures
② Application/approval records (within most recent year)
catShortTh: การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้

name: Account and access permission approval for other systems
content:
Are all of the following implemented　for issuing, changing, and deleting accounts and access privileges for systems other than critical systems ?

1. General accounts are approved by the Information Management Manager and administrator accounts are approved by the IT Manager.
2. Keep the above approval history for at least one year.
3. All of the following authority ranges and separations are satisfied
   1) Limit the scope of access privileges according to affiliation and position.
   2) Separate applicants and approvers for account access privileges
   3) Separate IDs for payment requesters and verifiers, developers and operators.
4. IDs that have been used once should not be reused for a certain period of time.
standard:
① Must establish procedures that satisfy the conditions to the left 1,2,3 for all systems other than important systems
② Operations must be in accordance with the procedures mentioned above
evidence:
① Documents describing procedures
② Application/approval records

name: Account sharing restrictions
content:
Is account sharing generally prohibited? If accounts must be shared, are the following implemented?

1. All shared accounts are known
2. There are valid reasons for sharing, and it is clear why and by whom these accounts are used
3. The use of environments is limited to listed users, or logs are checked after usage
4. If accounts are shared temporarily (for outsourced maintenance, etc.), accounts are shared only with required users and passwords are changed whenever the account is no longer shared
standard:
① There must be no shared accounts, or items 1, 2, 3, and 4 to the left must be performed for all general and administrator accounts
② Must periodically review the suitability of shared accounts (whether to use shared accounts or not, and who will use them)
evidence:
① Records of account sharing reasons, uses, users, and environments
① Records of temporary account lending
② Results of reviewing suitability
catShortTh: การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้

name: Disabling or deleting unnecessary accounts
content:
Are all of the following measures taken in relation to disabling or deleting accounts that are unnecessary for business operations?
 
1. Making an account unavailable by the last day of service in the case of an employee or the day the contract expires in the case of a subcontractor, etc.
2. Disabling or deleting an inactive account after a certain period of inactivity
standard:
① Must delete the accounts of all employees who leave the company and persons whose service contract is expiring, using one of the following methods
• Automatically delete or disable on the day the employee leaves or the day the contract expires
• Manually delete immediately after the retirement date or the contract expiration date (If it is difficult to delete on the same day, it is necessary to disable access by the account and invalidate or delete at an appropriate time such as monthly review)
② Must establish and follow procedures that satisfy item 2 to the left
evidence:
①② List of deleted/disabled accounts (within most recent year)
① List of employees who have left the company and persons whose service contracts have expired (within most recent year)
② Document that contains the procedures

name: Password Management
content:
Are all of the following measures taken in order to prevent a password from being known to anyone other than its user?

1. Require initial password change at first login
　　1) Provide a function to force a password change for the first time use.
　　2) If the above is not possible due to the system specifications, the system will inform the customer to change the password to one that only the customer knows at the time of issuance or at some other point in time.
2. Informing only the user of their password.
3. Masking passwords when users type them in (masking password characters with asterisks, etc.)
standard:
① PCs participating in AD must have their initial passwords changed
② Servers participating in AD must have their initial passwords changed
③ Must implement item 1 to the left for all passwords for individual systems (requesting that users change initial passwords)
④ Must maintain a practice that meets item 2 to the left
⑤ Must maintain a function that meets item 3 to the left
evidence:
①②Screenshot of AD account setup screen
③Screenshot of password change request screen or text of email inviting the change
④ Email notifications
⑤ Screenshots of password setting screens
catShortTh: การจัดการบัญชีผู้ใช้

category: 3.IT asset management and measures for IT devices
name: Asset management for PCs and OS/software
content:
Is the following information recorded as asset management for all PCs?

1.Maintain an asset management ledger that covers the following
 1) Device information: Device type, manufacturer, model, host name, user
 　*Host name: Computer name, serial number, etc.
 　*Location: Branch, branch name, building name, etc.
 2) OS information: Type, version, end of support
 3) Applications (Java/Adobe products, browsers, Office products, etc.): Type, version, end of support

2. All of the following measures are taken using the record noted above.
　1) Conducting a physical inventory (at least once a year)
　2) Monitoring expiration dates of support services for installed software (at least once a year)
standard:
① Must manage items 1 to the left using a ledger or configuration management system for all PCs
② Must not use OS/applications that are no longer supported
③ Must implement any of the following
a) Install a configuration management system and implement automatic updates
b) If using ledger management, keep applications, etc. updated by conducting a periodic review
evidence:
①②③ Files or management ledgers output from the configuration management system
③ Inventory result
catShortTh: การจัดการสินทรัพย์ IT

・ A system to prevent data from being saved to terminals

category: 3.IT asset management and measures for IT devices
name: Authentication, locking, and erasing data for smartphones and tablets
content:
Are the following implemented through MDM (Mobile Device Management), etc. for smartphones and tablets（“smartphones, etc.” hereafter)?

1.All of the following for company smartphones and other devices
・ Controls in place to prevent unauthorized changes to settings or modifications of functionality (Jailbreak,rooting,etc.)
・ Authentication is required upon startup or after a period of inactivity
・ Business data is deleted or devices can be locked remotely in case of loss or theft
・ Business data is deleted when devices are disposed of

2. All of the following measures are taken when personally-owned smartphones, etc. are used for work.
　・PIN authentication is required upon startup or resuming from pause
　・Business app data is deleted remotely in case of loss or theft
　・Business app data is deleted when smartphones, etc. are disposed of
standard: ① Must implement MDM or another similar system (MAM or another similar system in case of personally-owned smartphones, etc.) to control settings changes and function modifications and must configure settings so that items 1 and 2 to the left are satisfied, for all smartphones and tablets
evidence: ① Screenshots of configuration management screens for authentication, wiping, etc.
catShortTh: การจัดการสินทรัพย์ IT

name: Data encryption and storage location control for smartphones and tablets
content:
Are the following implemented through MAM (Mobile Application Management), etc. for smartphones and tablets whether they are company-owned or personally-owned ?

2. Saving to external storage media (SD cards, etc.) is prohibited
3. Business data can be stored only by company applications
standard: ① Must implement MAM or another similar system and must configure settings so that items 1, 2, and 3 to the left are satisfied for all smartphones and tablets
evidence:

② The frequency and method of backup must be appropriate in regard to the confidentiality and importance of stored information
evidence: ①② Backup configuration screen, service specifications and backup design documents, and configuration information of devices such as routers and firewalls (FW) installed between segments

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Backup restore procedures for important systems
content: Are backup recovery procedures in place for important systems?
standard: ① Must establish backup recovery procedures for all important systems
evidence: ① Backup restore procedures
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Monitoring and handling of endpoint terminals
content: Has EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) been implemented in a manner that satisfies "Appendix 4: Detection Scenario List" in order to collect and monitor endpoint logs in real-time and respond to threats when they are detected?
standard: ① Any EDR products used must satisfy requirements listed in "Appendix 4: Detection Scenario List"
evidence: ① Screenshots of management screens, etc.
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Incident monitoring, analysis, and response organizations
content:
Are the following implemented with regard to security event monitoring, analysis, and response?

1. There is a 24 hour, 365 day monitoring/response team
2. Either a) or b) applies to individuals responsible for monitoring and analysis
　　a) Individuals with experience in SOC-related work
　　b) Qualified IT security-related personnel with experience in IT security-related operations
3. Individuals responsible for providing responses have experience in IT security-related work
standard:
① Must ensure there is a 24 hour, 365 day response organization
② Must include individuals mentioned in items 2 and 3 to the left for said organization are qualified (relevant qualifications include the following)
• CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)
• GSEC/GCIH/GCIA: GIAC Security Certifications
• CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
evidence:
① Organization charts
② Member profiles (experience, skills, years of experience, etc.)
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Log monitoring and correlation analysis
content:
Are all of the following implemented with regard to log monitoring and analysis?

1. Endpoint and network device logs are collected in real-time
2. SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) has been implemented
3. Standards have been established for analyzing detected logs and critical (requiring immediate action) logs are always reviewed
4. Confirmation whether operations are being performed appropriately based on the standards above are conducted at least once per year
standard:
① Must introduce SIEM products with the functionality indicated in item 1 to the left and "Appendix 4: Detection Scenario List"
② Must store the results of reviews and audits described in items 3 and 4 to the left
evidence:
① Screenshots of SIEM management screens, log analysis standards, etc.
② Review / confirmation results (within most recent year)
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Rule modeling/tuning for SIEM, etc.
content: Are product detection/analysis rule modeling and tuning for SIEM, etc. performed based on the latest security threat information and for past over-detection or false detection incidents?
standard:
① Must implement functionality to analyze correlation from multiple log sources and identify security threats, such as a SIEM function
② Must tune rules as needed in a timely manner
evidence:
① Screenshots of correlation analysis screens
② Screenshots of rule configuration screens
② Tuning history for rules (minutes of review meetings, etc.)
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Initial response time when malware is detected
content: When a threat such as malware is detected, is there a target response time set in advance (from when the alert is detected until the endpoint is isolated from the network)?
standard:
① Must set an appropriate target response time from when detection occurs to when provisional measures are begun (approximately within three hours)
 ② The actual time from when detection occurs to when remediation begins must be within the target response time according to incident reports
evidence:
① SLA/operation design documents, etc. (describing target response times)
② Most recent incident response report
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Preparations for responding when a security incident occurs
content:
In regard to responding to when a security incident is detected, has a response procedure been prepared that includes the following

1. Initial actions and internal reports when an incident occurs; division of responsibilities, identification of scope of impact, etc.
2. Procedures for isolating from authentication servers and distribution servers shared with neighboring networks or other companies to prevent the spread of damage (spread of malware infection, etc.)
3. Report to M-CSIRT
4. Report to Marubeni's main department
standard:
① Must establish response procedures for items 1, 2, 3, and 4 to the left
②Training based on the relevant response procedures (verification of whether the procedures can be implemented according to the procedures) should be conducted on a regular basis.
evidence:
① Response procedure documents
②Training record
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

category: 7.Measures to prepare for incidents and failures
name: Reporting and responding when a security incident occurs
content:
Are the following operations conducted in accordance with the "Reporting Guideline for Security Incidents" and the "(same) Guideline for Response"?

1.Inform and implement reporting to the M-CSIRT and Marubeni's main department.
2. All of the following responses are implemented and recorded in the incident report
  1) Analysis/containment
  2) Eradication/restoration
  3) Prevention of recurrence
standard:
① Disseminate the contents of 1 on the left.
② Must implement items 1 and 2 to the left when an incident occurs and must record this in incident response reports
evidence:
① Memos
② Most recent incident response report
catShortTh: การเตรียมพร้อมรับเหตุการณ์

name: Security measures for file storage
content:
Are all of the following implemented for file storage that includes confidential information (all information assets except public information or information that could be made public)?

1. Access from the command line is controlled
2. Two-factor authentication
3. Controls are in place to prevent access using the AD administrator account (separate file storage administrator and AD administrator accounts)
4. Recorded logs cannot be deleted or changed even by system administrators
5. All files in storage are encrypted
6. Communication with file storage is encrypted
standard: ① File storage that is being used must satisfy items 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 to the left
evidence: ① File storage configuration screens, service specifications, responses from vendors, etc.
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Designation and dissemination of confidential information
content: Are information assets and their level of confidentiality, containing department, etc. listed as confidential information, and disseminated to employees?
standard:
① Must inform employees of the list described to the left (reference material: Appendix 5_Information Asset Management Standards Sample)
② Must periodically review list above
evidence:
① Memos (rules, training materials, individual memos, etc.)
② Records of reviews
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Storage and saving of confidential information
content:
Are all of the following implemented regarding storing and saving confidential information?

1. In principle, store and save data in high-security file storage, not in PCs or external storage media.
(In the event that a file server, etc., other than a high-security storage is used, the Information Manager must confirm that it does not contain confidential information.
2. Strictly confidential information(*) is separately stored/saved in folders, etc. from other information assets.

*An information asset that would have a serious impact on business management and operations, or information entities of clients if an information leakage was to occur (insider information, information related to fraud and noncompliance, highly confidential personal information, etc.)
standard:
①Must inform employees of the left operation rule
②Must provide dedicated storage areas by default for all strictly confidential information (folders, etc.)
③ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
evidence:
①Evidence that informing employees of the statement left has been done
② Screenshots of screens showing exclusive storage locations for strictly confidential information
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Default access permissions for file storage
content:
Are all of the following implemented with regard to access rights which is granted by default in strictly secure file storage?

1. Strictly confidential information is restricted to certain employees of the managing department (officers, etc., in the department)
2. Confidential information that is not highly confidential is restricted to employees in the managing department
standard:
① Must set permissions satisfying items 1 and 2 to the left by default for all storage locations for confidential information (folders, etc.)
② Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
evidence: ① Screenshots of access permission configuration screens for folders
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Individual permission approval and review
content:
When it is unavoidable for business reasons to allow access to confidential information by those other than users provided with access permissions by default, are the following implemented to limit access to the minimum level necessary, and only temporarily?

1. User accessible information assets, and operations (editing, downloading, etc.) can be limited
2. Granted and changed with the approval of an Information Manager (at least once per month for post-approval)
3. Permissions are reviewed at least twice per year and the results are reviwed and approved by an Information Manager
standard:
① Must provide file storage with functionality to perform items 1, 2, and 3 to the left
② Must store results for items 2 and 3 to the left
evidence:
① Screenshots of screens for granting individual permissions, or service specifications, manuals, etc.
② Approval/review records
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Means of sharing confidential information outside the company
content:
Is confidential digital information shared outside the company only with certain other organizations, etc., and stored/saved in highly secure file storage?
(Sharing through email attachments is generally prohibited even if passwords are set and attachments are encrypted)
standard:
① Must provide functionality (sharing links, etc.) to share data on file storage outside of the company
② Must provide functionality to prevent external sharing via email attachments or implement equivalent operations manually
③ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
evidence:
① Screenshots of sharing function screens (sharing links, etc.)
② Screenshots of email attachment control function screens, or evidence that informing employees
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Detection of removal of confidential information from file storage
content:
Are the following operations, which have a high possibility of inappropriate removal from highly secure file storage, detected by logs, etc. and notified to Information Manager, and does the manager instruct the subordinate to take action as necessary?

1. Granting access permissions to accounts that are highly likely to be for personal use (e.g., free email addresses)
2. An external user downloading a large number of files in a short period of time
standard:
① Must provide a system for file storage to immediately notify Information Managers when operations described in items 1 and 2 to the left are performed
② Information Managers must store records of confirming these notifications
③ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
evidence:
① Detection emails
② Records of checking detection emails
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Prevention of loss of crucial information, etc. in file storage
content:
Are the following implemented to prevent the loss of confidential information and information that must stored for a certain period of time from file storage due to internal and external negligence, etc.?

1. Functions are in place or used to prevent employees from completely deleting information, etc. (such as deleting information from the recycle bin)
2. Functions are in place or used to prevent information, etc. from being deleted before the retention period expires
standard:
① Must provide functionality to perform items 1 and 2 to the left, or must establish and disseminate operational procedures
② Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
evidence:
① Screenshots of configuration screens
① Memos (when responding with operations)
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Measures to prevent leakage of confidential information
content:
Are all of the following measures taken to prevent leakage of confidential information?

1. All of the following measures are taken to prevent information leakage from high-security file storage due to unauthorized access by internal/external parties or negligence.
 1) Functions are in place or used to restrict downloading, moving, and copying of individual files
 2) Functions are in place or used to add digital watermarks to files
2. As a general rule, the removal (including printing, creating other duplicates, or transferring data outside of the Company control) of confidential information in locations where there are many and unspecified people is prohibited; if required for business, keep removed confidential information to the minimum required for business purposes, and prevent information leaks (use snooping prevention filter, check surroundings, etc.) under approval from the Information Manager
standard:
① Must provide functionality to restrict downloading, moving, and copying individual files by external users, or must implement equivalent operations
② Equipped with a function (digital watermark, etc.) to prevent unauthorized removal, or to implement an operation equivalent to it.
③ Inform all employees of the security measures described on the left
④ Highly secure file storage corresponding to the information in item number 86 must be used
evidence:
① Configuration screen screenshots, or service specifications, etc.
② Screenshots of screens such as digital watermarks
①②(If it is supported by operation) Memos
③Memos
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Management of confidential documents
content:
Are all of the following implemented for the management of paper documents, electromagnetic storage media, etc. containing confidential information?

1.As a rule, store and save in a lockable place.
2. When a document specified as strictly confidential is to be taken out of the office, evidence of such removal is managed using a ledger.
standard:
① Must store confidential documents, etc. in locations that can be locked (safes, lockers, storehouses, etc.)
②Must maintain a record of strictly confidential documents taken out of the office
evidence:
① Photos of storage locations for confidential documents, etc.
②A record of strictly confidential documents taken out of the office
catShortTh: การจัดการสารสนเทศ

name: Means of sharing confidential documents, etc.
content: Is a method that allows users and recipients of documents to be identified and for the transfer status to be confirmed, when sharing paper documents and electromagnetic storage media containing confidential information?
standard: ① Must share confidential documents, etc. in a manner that allows handlers and recipients to be identified and to confirm the transfer status, etc. (registered mail, internal mail, hand delivery, etc.)
evidence: ① Records sent by registered mail, internal mail, etc.
